data.title: Regional airport upgrade plan taking off
data.description: The government is betting on regional airports to drive Thailand's next wave of tourism and investment growth, with upgrades to facilities, flight routes and technology aimed at transforming them into economic gateways.

data.title: PM beefs up border controls
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered tighter border controls after Myanmar requested that Thailand block the flow of weapons to ethnic armed groups across the frontier.</p>

data.title: Phuket nominee companies face financial probe
data.description: The Interior Ministry has ordered a financial trail investigation into more than 100 Phuket companies suspected of being linked to foreign nominee networks, with combined revenue estimated at more than 5 billion baht last year.

data.title: Singapore PM to visit Thailand next month
data.description: Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong will visit Thailand next month for the first Singapore-Thailand Leaders' Retreat in more than a decade.

data.title: Slimming down the state
data.description: The government is attempting what many administrations before it have promised but ultimately failed to achieve: shrinking the country's sprawling bureaucracy.

data.title: PM Anutin sorry over P-Move clash
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has apologised following a clash between members of the People's Movement for a Just Society (P-Move) and volunteer defence personnel at the Interior Ministry on Thursday.</p>

data.title: Appointment of former Yingluck aide questioned
data.description: Political activist Tul Sittisomwong has criticised the appointment of a former close aide to former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra as director of the Strategic Transformation Office (STO).

data.title: Government weighs second phase of co-payment scheme
data.description: The government will review its fiscal position before deciding whether to proceed with the second phase of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme or revise its conditions.

data.title: Tax breaks to lure carmakers
data.description: The Finance Ministry plans to introduce tax incentives by September to encourage foreign carmakers to establish production facilities in Thailand and increase the use of locally made components.

data.title: Central Retail to acquire MaxValu Thailand
data.description: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC) has agreed to acquire AEON (Thailand) Co Ltd, the operator of 30 MaxValu supermarkets in Thailand, in a move aimed at strengthening its food retail business and expanding the footprint of its Tops supermarket chain.

data.title: Nonthaburi school shooter said to be well behaved as death toll rises
data.description: NONTHABURI: Relatives of the 14-year-old suspect in Friday's deadly shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School described him as a quiet, well-behaved teenager who spent much of his time playing computer games, while investigators examining his computer found evidence that he had viewed videos of school shootings in the United States in the days leading up to the attack.

data.title: Thai PM vows new gun law after deadly school shooting
data.description: Within hours of a shooting rampage on the outskirts of Bangkok that left at least eight dead, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Friday vowed to introduce a new firearms control law in Southeast Asia's largest gun-owning nation.

data.title: Irish man found dead in Phuket lake
data.description: PHUKET - The body of a 28-year-old Irish man was found on Friday floating in the lake of a residential project.

data.title: Daughter stabs navy officer father during heated argument
data.description: Chon Buri - Police are questioning an 18-year-old girl after she allegedly stabbed her father, a naval officer, with a pair of scissors during an argument at their home in Sattahip district.

data.title: Eight dead in Nonthaburi school shooting
data.description: Eight people were killed and at least 22 others injured after gunfire erupted at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Bang Kruai district, Nonthaburi province, on Friday morning.

data.title: Former Dragon 5 singer found dead in Chao Phraya after cycling outing
data.description: Authorities have found the body of former Dragon 5 boy band member Thaman 'Tae' Taepun in the Chao Phraya River near Rama VII Bridge in Nonthaburi province, following his girlfriend's report to police that he had gone missing during a routine cycling outing.

data.title: 13 hurt after car hits child centre
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Thirteen children were injured when a car crashed into a child development centre in Muang district on Friday afternoon, police said.

data.title: HIV awareness gap puts young people at risk
data.description: Young people aged 15-24 remain at the highest risk of new HIV infections because many are unaware of prevention services, the Thai Red Cross has warned.
